positive_snippets: The hotel is very beautiful and the bed of the rooms are very comfortable.Staff is very polite and helpful.Dal makhni and snacks are very tasty.Mahanand,the manager is very hardworking and helps everyone who all face any kind of problem.

I had a wonderful stay at The palms inn Hotel. The staff were friendly and attentive, the room was clean and comfortable, and the overall atmosphere was relaxing. The location was convenient. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to others.
negative_snippets:
Worst hotel experience ever. This place has zero understanding of hospitality. They do not allow room delivery and force guests to come down in the middle of the night to collect parcels, even when you’re exhausted.
We were treated more like hostel residents than paying hotel guests. No empathy, no flexibility, no basic courtesy.
If you’re tired, sick, traveling with family, or expecting comfort — avoid this hotel at all costs. Policies here are designed for staff convenience, not guest comfort. Completely ruined our stay.

Very disappointing experience. The hotel does not allow outside food delivery and forces guests to buy hotel food at extremely high prices. Delivery boys are not permitted to come to the room, and shockingly, hotel staff also refuse to assist with delivery.

Guests are asked to come down themselves to collect deliveries or important items, which causes unnecessary inconvenience and discomfort—especially for tired travelers, families, or unwell guests. This policy is not guest-friendly and creates avoidable trouble.

Such restrictions should be clearly informed before booking. Overall, this ruined the stay experience. Would not recommend.
